offering_description.value: Produces natural gas from its shale wells in North Texas and sells it to pipelines, marketers and power generators. It also operates a gas-fired power plant and gathering system in the same region, and sells the electricity and carbon-related services to customers.

primary_products.value: natural gas; natural gas liquids; electricity

primary_services.value: gas gathering; water management; carbon capture and storage

customer_segment.value: B2B: natural gas pipelines, marketers and utilities, power grid operators and large industrial buyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: natural gas, natural gas liquids and electricity sold to buyers; service fees: gathering and water management services for other producers

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: produces natural gas from its wells, sold to pipelines, marketers and power buyers; asset operator: operates wells, gathering pipelines and a power plant in Texas, selling to energy customers

geography_served.value: US regional: North Texas, mainly the Barnett Shale region

specialization.value: related lines: natural gas production, gas gathering and power generation sharing the same Texas asset base

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: gas and power sold directly to pipelines, marketers, utilities and grid operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: oil and gas environmental and air permits from the Texas Railroad Commission and EPA, power plant grid rules
